prompt: More than one employee is named David Brown. Return only the employee number of the David Brown who works in department 1 and was hired in 2025.

steps.text: The user wants the employee number of David Brown who works in department 1 and was hired in 2025. There are multiple David Browns.
The query returned two David Browns in department 1. One was hired in 2025 (EMP-698636, hire_date 2025-05-15) and one in 2021 (EMP-771204). The answer is EMP-698636.
